deadline.value: Submit all material by January 3 for fall admission; the department encourages submitting by December 17.
deadline.quote: To ensure full consideration of your application, please submit all material by September 28 (for Spring admission) or January 3rd (for Fall admission)

also.quote: Applications may stack up over the winter holiday, so earlier submission for Fall admission (by 17 December) is encouraged

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact faculty before applying.
supervisor.quote: We strongly encourage you to contact specific professors who match your interests before applying

funding.value: All accepted students can receive TA support for up to five years, although the department calls its awards competitive.
funding.quote: All accepted students can receive support from the department as a Teaching Assistant for up to 5 years assuming that they continue to make progress toward their degree

entry_route.value: Qualified students usually go straight into the PhD without first earning a master's.
entry_route.quote: Qualified students usually enter the Ph.D. program without first earning a M.S. degree

toefl_min.value: Department requires a TOEFL iBT of 100 (or equivalent) for international applicants without an English-based degree.
toefl_min.quote: Applicants must score at least 100 (iBT) or equivalent on the TOEFL (for international students who have not received a degree from an English-based institution) to be considered for admission

english_waiver.value: Exemption depends on having a degree from an English-based institution; the page does not define that term.
english_waiver.quote: for international students who have not received a degree from an English-based institution

app_fee.value: The department's fee for nonimmigrant applicants is $70.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

notes: The department lists Biochemistry and Biological Sciences degrees. Teaching assistantships are provided for up to five years; the minimum PhD stipend is stated as $23,000 over nine months. The GRE is no longer required (page statements dated 2020 onward).
